annotations.title: Benchmark your MRR against category peers

description: Use when the user gives their own MRR or asks whether their revenue is good compared with similar AI businesses. Returns where an MRR ranks among fresh same-category MRR peers (rank of N + 1 comparable). Example: {"category":"customer-support","mrr":2000} -> your rank among the customer-support MRR peers + 1 comparable. Also: N, basis, verification date, peer caveat; no growth numbers yet; your MRR is never stored. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

category.description: Category slug, e.g. customer-support, automation-platforms, sales-gtm, indie-solo (see list_categories).

full.description: Full answers are paused (paid tier paused while we confirm source permissions); you get the free answer.

months_live.description: Optional months since launch (0-600). Accepted but ignored for now.

mrr.description: Your monthly recurring revenue in USD, e.g. 2000 (greater than 0, at most 100000000). Not stored.

report_token.description: Not used while the paid tier is paused.
